description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7): squatters hold the hill of Shepherd's Watch and its beacon is cold (the quest starts when the giant finds the watch or comes within 150 m of it). Clear them and relight it: 80 XP, the watch's view (the places within 600 m on the map), its light column in the sky; the watch's cache lies by the waystone.

stages.objective: Clear the squatters and relight Shepherd's Watch
